result.quote: So he covertly sent messengers to Abimelech to say, “Look, Gaal son of Ebed and his brothers have come to Shechem and are stirring up the city against you.
result.reason: The warning’s content is directly supported, and no materially different answer is suggested. However, the window identifies the sender only as “he”; it never names Zebul or supplies an antecedent establishing that identity. Thus the attribution to Zebul requires missing context. The edit preserves the source pair’s intended focus on the warning about Gaal inciting the city.
